fetch_url.description: The clone fetch URL (interface: Clone resolution): the URL of repos.<id>.remote, fetch form (https userinfo stripped, a plain ssh user kept, any password dropped), normalized to the repo id, unchanged by ls-remote --get-url; stored with the clone and verified on every resolution. Push target of the clean checkout.

default_branch.description: The remote's default branch, the value stored in the repo's clones row by the last mirror refresh (never read from the clone or from the mirror's HEAD); null if none was stored.
